column2: Description
EU data protection regulation - Privacy policy, consent management, data export/deletion
Payment card industry security - Tokenization, no card storage, quarterly scans
Comprehensive, lawyer-reviewed privacy policy published
Legal terms and conditions, lawyer-reviewed
Detailed cookie usage policy and consent banner
Clear refund and return policy for customers
Marketplace user agreement for buyers and sellers
Designated DPO (if required), contact information published
Users can request their personal data
Account deletion with data anonymization
Users can edit all personal information
Export user data in machine-readable format (JSON/CSV)
Opt-out mechanisms for marketing and profiling
Track and manage user consent for data processing
Procedures for notifying users within 72 hours
Mechanisms to prevent underage user registration
DMCA takedown procedures, user content policies
Verify sellers not selling counterfeit items
Transaction monitoring, suspicious activity reporting
Sales tax collection and reporting mechanisms
WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for web and mobile
Apple App Store and Google Play Store guidelines
KYC (Know Your Customer) for marketplace sellers
Policies and tools for inappropriate content removal
Mechanism to notify users of policy changes
